name: Lazarus
bio: In a parable Jesus told, Lazarus was a poor beggar covered in sores who lay at the gate of a rich man, longing for the crumbs from his table. When he died, angels carried him to Abraham's side; the rich man, who had ignored him in life, died and was tormented in hell, and begged Abraham to send Lazarus to warn his five brothers, but Abraham replied that if they would not listen to Moses and the prophets, neither would they be persuaded even by someone risen from the dead (Luke 16:19-31). He is the only character Jesus names within a parable, and is a different figure from Lazarus of Bethany, whom Jesus later raised from death.
